name: aldra-asm
title: ALDRA-ASM — an assembler for the HELIOS-16 ISA
description: Build ALDRA-ASM: a C assembler for the HELIOS-16 instruction set. It reads a .asm file (labels, ORG, and the mnemonics LOAD/STORE/ADD/SUB/AND/OR/XOR/SHL/SHR/CMP/JMP/JEQ/SET with register and address operands) and emits a raw 16-bit image as hex text lines and a .bin. It must assemble the classic add program and print ALDRA:PASS when the emitted bytecode equals the known-good sequence.
context: Two-pass assembler: pass 1 collects labels, pass 2 emits opcodes. Opcode map: 0000 LOAD, 0001 STORE, 0010 ADD, 0011 SUB, 0100 AND, 0101 OR, 0110 XOR, 0111 SHL, 1000 SHR, 1001 CMP, 1010 JMP, 1011 JEQ, 1100 SET. R-type: {op(4), rd(4), rs(4)}. L/S: {op(4), rd(4), addr(8)}. Branch: {op(4), addr(8)}. SET: {1100, rd(4), imm(8)}. Makefile builds asm.

manifest.purpose: main assembler: two passes, opcode table, label resolution
mnemonic -> opcode table and register names

criteria: runs:sh -c "cd /home/rox/work/aldra-asm && make && ./asm test_prog.asm && test -s prog.hex && echo ALDRA:PASS"
